units: pixels (full 3840x2160 frame, x right, y down) and seconds; time = frame / 22.297248
summary: Static close-up of a white tiled wall with a white suction-cup toilet-roll holder. A right hand slides an empty grey-brown cardboard toilet-paper tube to the right along the holder's horizontal arm, the tube clears the arm's end-plate at frame ~24.8, then hand and tube swing down-right and leave the frame at the bottom right (tube gone after frame 32, hand after frame 33).

camera.evidence: 7 grout-line probes drift < 1.2 px over the whole clip (scene/camera_shift.json); no background compensation needed
camera.exposure: mean grey rises steadily 175 -> 189 (auto exposure / lighting), irrelevant to geometry
camera.perspective: near fronto-parallel view of a flat wall; tile grout lines are not perfectly straight/parallel (lower horizontal grout y 1733 at left -> 1772 at right; tile widths 1550-1630 px), so ~2-5% scale variation across the frame from tile laying/lens; the tube moves ~2-15 cm in front of the wall (on the holder arm), at roughly constant depth

objects.name: tube
objects.aka: empty toilet-paper roll / cardboard tube / cardboard roll core
objects.appearance: grey-brown cardboard cylinder with a diagonal spiral seam, held by its right end in the right hand

size_px.length_note: horizontal extent from left end (x 1716) to the open right end (x 2271) at frame 0, row y=1300; the only frame where both ends are visible. Axis tilt ~ -4 deg so along-axis length ~557. Consistent with frame 22 (left end 2196, right end hidden ~2755). Uncertainty +-10 px.
size_px.diameter_note: top-to-bottom silhouette at frames 15-25 (unoccluded part): 258-264 px; frames 0-14 partly covered by fingers (240-250 measured, less reliable); frames 26-31 motion blur inflates to 265-280
size_px.visible_mask_length: 564-610 px along PCA axis, frames 0-28 (includes end ellipse; fingers hide the right end)

objects.reference_point: ctr_est_x/ctr_est_y in tube.csv = left end + 277.5 px in x, vertical middle of silhouette; left_end_x is the most reliable single coordinate (always visible, sharp until frame ~28)

objects.name: hand
objects.aka: right hand and forearm of the person (only arm visible; dark grey-green sleeve at right edge)
objects.appearance: skin-coloured right hand entering from the right edge, gripping the tube's right end between thumb and fingers
objects.note: mask = skin pixels (hand + forearm), truncated by the right/bottom image edge, so bbox right side and centroid are not of the whole hand; leftmost_x = fingertip/thumb tip

after release from the arm the tube is carried down-right (direction change from ~horizontal to ~down-right ~50 deg below horizontal)
tube reaches bottom image edge, partly out of frame
hand last visible (fingertips at bottom-right corner)
only static wall and holder visible
